Name: More Consistent Books
Author: BeazNees
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/AHXrDYm.png[/img]﻿

Are you like me, getting so needlessly annoyed by the fact that not all the book sprites have the same base? 
Yes? This this mod is for you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n5zCjQ9.png[/img]﻿

This is a very simple retexture mod that changes some book sprites so that they are cohesive (in my opinion, I should mention).
Every single edit is configurable, and you can enable/disable them to your liking. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NbnSfut.png[/img]﻿

Compatible with everything [i]besides [/i]mods that also edit book sprites.[/center]

Downloads.Description: Reupload to be a .zip file instead of .rar after being informed people can have issue with the latter. Identical to the former version, just zip.
